Manickam Tagore Appointed Tamil Nadu Congress Committee President

Manickam Tagore has been appointed as the new president of the Tamil Nadu Congress Committee. This leadership change occurs as the Congress party has recently ended its alliance with the DMK and formed a new coalition with the TVK, aiming to gain political influence in the state.
